mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS room_id, r.name AS room_name, COUNT(m.id) AS meeting_count, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(m.start_time, #{rangeStart}), LEAST(m.end_time, #{rangeEnd}))), 0) AS total_minutes FROM meeting_room r LEFT JOIN meeting m ON m.room_id = r.id AND m.status IN (20, 30, 40) AND m.start_time < #{rangeEnd} AND m.end_time > #{rangeStart} GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name

SELECT DATE(m.start_time) AS date, COUNT(m.id) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(m.start_time, #{rangeStart}), LEAST(m.end_time, #{rangeEnd}))), 0) AS minutes FROM meeting m WHERE m.status IN (20, 30, 40) AND m.start_time >= #{rangeStart} AND m.start_time < #{rangeEnd} AND (m.organiser_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meeting_participant p WHERE p.meeting_id = m.id AND p.user_id = #{userId})) GROUP BY DATE(m.start_time) ORDER BY date
